_doc: Niagara County's legislative districts, as the law draws them: Local Law No. 2 of 2022, the county's reapportionment plan, lists each district as 2020 census blocks (tract, then block numbers). These are the rows of the three districts that cover North Tonawanda (7, 8 and 9), typed from the filed law's pages 2b and 2c exactly as printed: district, city or town, tract, block ranges ('1000-1002 2000-2007' = blocks 1000 to 1002 and 2000 to 2007). Read by tools/build_districts.py, which expands the ranges and checks them against the Census Bureau's own list of the city's blocks: every one of North Tonawanda's 444 blocks must appear exactly once. The other twelve districts are not typed here: no other municipality's roll is on this site.
_update: Re-type only when the County adopts a new reapportionment plan (after the 2030 census): its local law replaces this one, and the rows below must be re-read from its pages. The scan's text layer scrambles the rows, so read the page images, never the text layer.

law.title: Local Law No. 2 of 2022, a local law for the Reapportionment Plan of the County of Niagara, New York
law.certified: Passed by the Niagara County Legislature on June 21, 2022 and approved by the Chairman of the Legislature the same day; subject to permissive referendum, and no valid petition requesting one was filed as of August 4, 2022 (the law's certification, page 3 of 4).
law.pages: pages 2b and 2c (pages 3 and 4 of the PDF)
law.current: The County's local-laws page lists this law as its reapportionment plan, with no later one through 2026 (checked 2026-10-30).

typed: 2026-10-30, from the page images at 260 dpi; checked against the Census Bureau's 2020 block assignment file: the North Tonawanda rows name all 444 of the city's blocks, each once, and no block that does not exist. A second check: the rows' 2020 populations (the Census Bureau's POP100 for each block, TIGERweb) sum to 14,095 for District 7, 14,039 for District 8 and 14,084 for District 9, three near-equal districts, as a reapportionment plan draws them.
